source_user: Two serving systems claim different tokens/s. Design a reproducible comparison. Scenario variant 282: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: freeze model revision, tokenizer, precision, hardware, topology, prompt/generation distributions, concurrency, warmup, stopping rules, and telemetry; publish raw request traces.
corrected_answer:
For scenario variant 282, define the comparison before measuring it. Assume both systems can run the same model revision, tokenizer, precision, decoding and stop rules; if any cannot, report that as a limitation rather than silently comparing different workloads. Pin runtime and serving configuration, hardware and topology, clocks/power limits, software dependencies, request corpus and prompt/output distributions, concurrency, offered load, admission, batching, cache state, network path, quality target, warmup, run duration, and stopping/inclusion rules.

State a falsifiable hypothesis tied to one named mechanism—for example, scheduler overhead or a kernel implementation causes the residual throughput difference when all other factors are held fixed. The hypothesis is disconfirmed if the effect is within a predeclared practical margin, reverses across randomized paired trials, or disappears when that mechanism is controlled. Use the same immutable request IDs in repeated paired crossover runs, randomize system order, test several offered-load/concurrency points, exclude warmup by rule, and report effect sizes, uncertainty, and failed or incomplete requests rather than a best run.

Define every token metric with numerator, denominator, and units: input-token/s, generated-token/s, and accepted-token/s where relevant. Separately report end-to-end wall-clock throughput and latency (queue, admission, dispatch, time-to-first-token, inter-token and completion), and state whether queueing, network, retries, cancellations, failures, padding, speculative/rejected tokens, and idle time are included. Capture request IDs plus synchronized timestamps and configuration/workload hashes; publish raw traces, analysis code, and the quality/correctness checks. Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, GPU/CPU/memory/power/thermal utilization, queue depth, batch sizes, errors/timeouts/retries, and output quality with confidence intervals.

Treat cache warmth, prompt-length mix, output-length/early-stop mix, tokenizer accounting, batching/admission, autoscaling, contention, thermal throttling, clock changes, network variance, implementation maturity, and missing telemetry as confounders. A trace that cannot distinguish queue from service time limits causal claims. Do not deploy an unvalidated winner solely on tokens/s: stage a canary with fixed traffic and quality/error/latency/resource SLOs, observe rollback windows, and fail closed to the known-good system on threshold breach, correctness or safety regression, missing telemetry, or unexplained variance. Record the rollback decision and preserve artifacts for independent review.

Minimum technical points: freeze model revision, tokenizer, precision, hardware, topology, prompt/generation distributions, concurrency, warmup, stopping rules, and telemetry; publish raw request traces.
corrected_answer:
For scenario variant 291, define the comparison before measuring it. Assume both systems can run the same model revision, tokenizer, precision, decoding and stop rules; if any cannot, report that as a limitation rather than silently comparing different workloads. Pin runtime and serving configuration, hardware and topology, clocks/power limits, software dependencies, request corpus and prompt/output distributions, concurrency, offered load, admission, batching, cache state, network path, quality target, warmup, run duration, and stopping/inclusion rules.

State a falsifiable hypothesis tied to one named mechanism—for example, scheduler overhead or a kernel implementation causes the residual throughput difference when all other factors are held fixed. The hypothesis is disconfirmed if the effect is within a predeclared practical margin, reverses across randomized paired trials, or disappears when that mechanism is controlled. Use the same immutable request IDs in repeated paired crossover runs, randomize system order, test several offered-load/concurrency points, exclude warmup by rule, and report effect sizes, uncertainty, and failed or incomplete requests rather than a best run.

Define every token metric with numerator, denominator, and units: input-token/s, generated-token/s, and accepted-token/s where relevant. Separately report end-to-end wall-clock throughput and latency (queue, admission, dispatch, time-to-first-token, inter-token and completion), and state whether queueing, network, retries, cancellations, failures, padding, speculative/rejected tokens, and idle time are included. Capture request IDs plus synchronized timestamps and configuration/workload hashes; publish raw traces, analysis code, and the quality/correctness checks. Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, GPU/CPU/memory/power/thermal utilization, queue depth, batch sizes, errors/timeouts/retries, and output quality with confidence intervals.

Treat cache warmth, prompt-length mix, output-length/early-stop mix, tokenizer accounting, batching/admission, autoscaling, contention, thermal throttling, clock changes, network variance, implementation maturity, and missing telemetry as confounders. A trace that cannot distinguish queue from service time limits causal claims. Do not deploy an unvalidated winner solely on tokens/s: stage a canary with fixed traffic and quality/error/latency/resource SLOs, observe rollback windows, and fail closed to the known-good system on threshold breach, correctness or safety regression, missing telemetry, or unexplained variance. Record the rollback decision and preserve artifacts for independent review.

quality_dimensions.mechanism: explicit falsifiable mechanism hypothesis with randomized paired crossover and control intervention
quality_dimensions.boundaries: token definitions, timing boundaries, workload, operating points, and failure treatment specified
quality_dimensions.measurement: unit-labeled traces, performance, resources, errors, correctness, quality, and uncertainty specified
quality_dimensions.safety: canary SLOs, telemetry gates, and fail-closed rollback specified

risks: token denominator or timing-boundary mismatch
cache, workload, batching, autoscaling, thermal, network, or telemetry confounding
quality/correctness regression or unsafe rollout
overclaiming causality from observational or incomplete traces
evidence_required: pinned configurations and hashed request corpus
published raw request traces, workload hash, and analysis code
repeated paired results with uncertainty, disconfirmation tests, and quality checks
canary SLO, error, resource, correctness, and safety observations
